overview_description.description:
ApplyBoard is a technology company that simplifies the study abroad search, application, and acceptance process by connecting international students, recruitment partners, and educational institutions on a single platform. Through its platform and team of experts, the application process is streamlined from discovery and application to enrollment, assisting thousands of students in pursuing their dreams of studying abroad.


In 2023, ApplyBoard was named one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada by Deloitte as part of its Fast 50 and Fast 500 rankings. This marked the fifth consecutive year that ApplyBoard was recognized by Deloitte as one of North America’s fastest-growing companies.

The ApplyBoard Team has grown rapidly in the past 8 years, employing more than 1,200 team members. The ApplyBoard headquarters is located in downtown Kitchener, Ontario, a dedicated office in Gurugram, India, and team members in 30 countries including Nepal, Bangladesh, China, the Philippines, Vietnam, the United Kingdom, Brazil, Mexico, and the United States.

about_short_description.short_description: ApplyBoard is a study abroad application platform that connects students, recruitment partners, and educational institutions.

product.name: ApplyBoard Study Abroad Platform
product.description: An online platform for finding international study programs, comparing institutions, preparing applications, and submitting to partner schools in supported destinations.

product.name: ApplyBoard 360 Solutions
product.description: A collection of services supporting international students from application through arrival, including financial products, language testing, foreign exchange, accommodation, and visa assistance.

product.name: ApplyBoard Institutional Recruitment Solutions
product.description: Recruitment and enrollment technology and services for universities, colleges, and schools seeking international applicants and more efficient application processing.

product.name: ApplyBoard Recruitment Partner Network
product.description: A platform and support program for education agents and recruitment organizations to search programs, submit applications, and support international students.

product.name: ApplyProof
product.description: A document-verification platform that enables secure verification of student financial-support documents for international enrollment and study permit processes.

product.name: ApplyBoard Student Education Loans
product.description: Education loan facilitation for international students, covering eligible study, living, travel, and education-related expenses through lending partners.
